workingDecisions.customerBaseline: 6ft, 40.9dBi, antenna center 21.5m, azimuth toward ZWP8 94.32deg, RPT/BOD
workingDecisions.offerBasis: 4ft candidate is deliberately preferred by ADDVALUE management IF feasible. Keep distinct vendor 4ft source and chosen cost for internal working budget.
engineeringProof: OEM 4ft realized gain, EIRP and RF output
Independent FSPL, link fade/availability >=99.99% and actual throughput/QoS
Antenna height/reflection by tidal variation, antenna polarization and spatial clearance
Mounting/structure wind load, access, Ex RF safety and regulatory licence
workingDecisions.failAction: If 4ft cannot meet mandatory functions, evaluate feasible antenna/configuration alternatives and quantify cost delta; do not assume unconditional approval
workingDecisions.drawingImpact: GA/LAY/RPT/BOM route lengths/supports may change; submit required design revision/deviation when departure from specified size is confirmed

workingDecisions.offerBasis: Antenna site mounting point and azimuth are physical design attributes, not the customer TAG identity. Retain TAG unless function, count, scope ownership or approved customer requirement changes.
engineeringProof: Location safe area/access and correct 94.32deg orientation basis
Unobstructed antenna swing and actual mounting height
Layout/cable tray route & penetrations, grounding, supports, RF cable type and loss
New link and hazardous area study if relocation affects them
workingDecisions.changeTrigger: If relocation materially changes scope, performance, zone, existing tie-in, antenna count, approved location or cost, issue LAY/GA/CAL/MTO revision and necessary client clarification; request MR/TAG revision only if client-defined equipment identity or scope itself changes

workingDecisions.customerBaseline: BOD 7.2 existing ZPQ NMS and SPE 6.1.7 extension to existing NMS, valid licence through equipment life.
workingDecisions.offerBasis: Existing Z1A-Z1E NMS platform assumed available; not proven that free monitoring channels, nodes, sensors or OEM licences are sufficient for new/brownfield devices.
engineeringProof: Existing NMS vendor/version, serial/host and admin access
Licence family and licensed/consumed/free sensor/port/node count
SNMP version, alarms, severity mapping, network reachability, cyber requirements
OEM compatibility and additional licences/evergreen rights
Site engineering/FAT/SAT and ZPQ integration workload

scenarios.condition: Existing licensed node/sensor capacity sufficient and compatible
scenarios.licenceIncrementBasis: Only if explicitly verified not required; no blind USD0 in quote
scenarios.services: Engineering, configuration, test, document and travel still costed

scenarios.condition: Existing platform supports extension but extra seats/nodes/sensors required
scenarios.licenceIncrementBasis: Price OEM extension from documented node/sensor delta, source unit rate, perpetual term

scenarios.condition: Existing NMS incompatible or insufficient; separate upgrade/change beyond base assumption
scenarios.hardwareCostBasis: Conditional separate scope/variation after existing system review
scenarios.licenceIncrementBasis: Vendor upgrade/new entitlement priced independently; not hidden in workbook Part C spares

workingDecisions.quantityDriver: NMS_licences_required = MAX(0,new_supported_endpoint_or_sensor_demand - verified_reusable_existing_capacity) using equal licence units
workingDecisions.costPostingRule: Do not zero licence cost when remaining capacity is unknown; use conditional commercial qualification and an explicitly sourced provisional allowance only if an evidential driver/rate exists
